episodes.title: The Only Round That Matters Is the Next One
episodes.summary: After eight years in a Nevada prison, former heavyweight boxing champion Duke Kilroy returns home to London, intent on avenging his brother's death.

episodes.title: Brick by Brick
episodes.summary: Duke must improvise to keep his mission on track, but he finds that success comes at a cost.

episodes.title: No Innocents
episodes.summary: Turning up the heat on the Marshalls, Duke is drawn in deeper than he ever could have imagined.

episodes.title: Protect Yourself at All Times
episodes.summary: London's gangland is pushed to the brink of war. But for Duke, the consequences strike painfully close to home.

episodes.title: I Want This
episodes.summary: A deadly rescue mission opens up new possibilities for Duke, until an almighty twist causes his overwhelming need for revenge to eclipse him once more.

episodes.title: There Is a War Coming
episodes.summary: Duke prepares for his long-awaited shot at revenge, while others take matters into their own hands.

episodes.title: Without Me, There Is No You
episodes.summary: With time running out and relationships breaking apart, Duke closes in on his target, but an unexpected countermove leaves him staring down the barrel of defeat.

episodes.title: You Won't See Me Coming
episodes.summary: An explosive showdown leads Duke to a surprising truth, rocking him to the core, as an audacious move captures the world's attention.
